text: Bitcoin is consolidating at strong levels with modest daily gains, while Ethereum is flat—suggesting traders are holding positions rather than rotating aggressively between the two majors. The Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) with stable sentiment over the week indicates confidence without euphoria, supported by $94B in daily volume and Bitcoin's 58.4% dominance showing no sudden capital flight. Altcoins like BNB and SOL are tracking Bitcoin's mild upside, pointing to a risk-on environment with steady but measured momentum.
